text:
Maya K: Quick heads-up — we need a checklist for the joint announcement + marketplace listing for our LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters + gateway integrations with CloudPartner. Key asks: compatibility matrix, perf on partner HW, docs + sample app, license & billing guidance, go-to-market timeline. :eyes:

Sam R: Agree. Can we define certification tests? perf thresholds (p50, p95), and supported model variants (FP16/INT8)?

Chris P: I'll own perf. Need target SKUs from CloudPartner (H100,H200) + container images for private customers. Will run 1k qps sim and end-to-end latency. Also capturing token cost delta.

Anya: I'll build the integration test matrix. Propose rows: adapter version, langchain schema, llamaindex connector, gateway route config, auth mode. Columns: smoke, perf, security, regression.

Partners PM: Timeline request — marketing wants a press schedule. Can we target a marketplace listing + joint blog in 6 weeks? Need partner legal sign-off for logos.

Maya K: 6 weeks ok if we parallelize. Action owners: Chris perf, Anya tests, Sam docs & SDK examples, Maya coordinates with CloudPartner. Partners PM to schedule partner review.

Sam R: Draft of docs snippet for adapter config:
```
adapter:
  name: redwood-langchain-adapter
  runtime: gateway-v2
  compat: [langchain>=0.1.5, llamaindex>=0.5.0]
  quantization: int8
```

Chris P: Perf plan quick notes: run aisim with varying seq len (128/512), batch sizes (1/8/32), measure p50/p95, GPU mem, and kernel fallback.

Anya: Need test harness for private deployments (VPC). Any infra pointers? @deploy-bot share test env link pls.

Deploy Bot: test-env-updates-prod · link: https://deploys.redwood.ci/testenvs/llamaindex-gateway — image built (sha: a1b2c3), 2 nodes H100 auto-scale enabled.

Partners PM: Legal sent logo ok, just need final release copy by next Friday. :thumbsup:

Maya K: Great. I'll compile checklist doc and share draft tomorrow. If anyone has open blockers, drop them here.

Sam R: One blocker — need sample prompt templates to validate output parity across adapters. I'll add to docs backlog.

Chris P: Also confirm default tokenization differences between models — otherwise metrics will be noisy.

Maya K: Good call. Tagging action items:
- Chris P: perf runs & report
- Anya: test matrix + harness
- Sam R: docs + sample prompts
- Partners PM: legal & marketing timelines

Maya K: Closing thread for now, will post the checklist link when ready. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
